title: docs(skills): a pair-added email template locale is served on the base's address; another package's added locale stays under its own package (#28802 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

Filing gate: ① a docs follow-up owed by PR #28828 (card #28802), named in its `Skills-docs:` line and confirmed by its contract review. Filed by `domain:server` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p3 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: an author or agent who adds an email template locale in a `<base>.custom` pair, or ships one from a package that depends on the base.

## What changes once PR #28828 merges

- A locale added in the `<base>.custom` pair (no `overrides`) is served on the base's address: listed in `GET /meta/email_template` and `?package=<base>`, in the execution list, and used by a send in that locale.
- A locale another package adds under the base template's name is served only under `?package=<that package>`. The base-named and package-less reads no longer answer it.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` state the two rules above, next to the rule #28778 adds (an override names a shipped locale; a new locale carries no `overrides`).
- Land after PR #28828 and after PR #28814 (#28778), which edits the same two files, so the three rules read as one passage.

Dedupe: #28778 / PR #28814 covers the write-gate rule only. **New.**
